summary: Pet Idle v2 (Gun Idle style) complete testing. All features working: battle arena with auto-attack, tap bonus damage with floating numbers, target HP system, coin earning, player level progression, animal unlocking, upgrade system, and backend save/load for logged-in users.
passed_tests: Game page loads at /idle-game with data-testid='idle-game-page'
Battle arena component visible with data-testid='battle-arena'
Coin display shows current coins (starts at 0)
DPS display shows current damage per second (starts at 1/s with Bunny)
Player Level 1 displayed with XP progress bar
Bunny (Tier 1) starts unlocked at Level 1
Bunny auto-attacks target - green projectile dots visible flying toward target
Target has HP bar that decreases over time (confirmed decreasing from 10 to 0)
Tapping battle arena deals bonus damage
Floating damage numbers appear on tap (-1 red text animates upward)
When target HP reaches 0: coins earned, XP gained, new stronger target spawns
Coins increase from destroying targets (verified 0 -> 17 -> 112 coins)
DPS display updates when animals upgraded (1/s -> 2/s after Bunny upgrade)
Upgrade button costs coins and increases animal DPS
Player XP increases when targets destroyed (verified 0 -> 9/10 XP)
Player levels up when XP fills (verified Level 1 -> Level 2 -> Level 3)
New animals unlock at level milestones (Kitty unlocked at Level 3)
Locked animals show unlock level requirement (e.g., 'Unlocks at Lv.3')
Animal roster shows correct DPS and level (e.g., 'Bunny Lv.2 2/s')
YOUR ANIMALS count updates when new animals unlock (1 -> 2)
Next unlock indicator in header (e.g., 'Next: Kitty @ Lv.3' -> 'Next: Pigy @ Lv.5')
Prestige button appears when eligible (needs 50k+ totalEarned coins)
Bottom navigation Pet Idle center button works and has elevated styling
Navigation between Pet Idle and other pages works
Backend GET /api/idle-game/state requires auth (returns 401)
Backend GET /api/idle-game/state returns state for logged-in user
Backend POST /api/idle-game/save requires auth (returns 401)
Backend POST /api/idle-game/save saves v2 game state
Backend state persistence verified (save -> get returns same data)
Backend validates request body (returns 422 for missing 'state' key)
Backend prestige data persists correctly
critical_code_review_comments: Code quality: Clean implementation of Gun Idle mechanics with battle arena
50 animals defined with progressive unlock levels - good progression curve
Auto-save interval set to 30 seconds - appropriate for idle game
localStorage key 'petIdle_v2' differentiates from old merge-grid version
All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pet Idle v2 (Gun Idle style) is fully functional. This is a complete rewrite from the old merge-grid game. Key mechanics: (1) Battle arena shows active animal shooting projectiles at a target, (2) Target has HP bar that decreases from auto-attacks and tap damage, (3) Destroying targets earns coins and XP, (4) Player levels up and unlocks new animals (Kitty at Lv.3, Pigy at Lv.5, etc.), (5) Animal roster is scrollable list with upgrade buttons, (6) Prestige button appears after earning 50k+ total coins. Backend APIs at /api/idle-game/state (GET) and /api/idle-game/save (POST) work for logged-in users. Auto-save every 30 seconds. localStorage key is 'petIdle_v2'. First 12 animal tiers have custom images, higher tiers use emoji.

mocked_apis.note: All idle game APIs are real - no mocking
